verdict.rationale: Gumroad is a creator marketplace in its own right. The evidence does not document any developer-facing platform capability for onboarding third-party sellers, splitting payments between parties, or paying out to each seller in a marketplace the developer builds. The public API covers products, sales, subscribers and licenses, and the OAuth/MCP access lets an agent check payouts for a single connected creator; both are adjacent to the story, not split payments or multi-seller payouts. Forking the source-available codebase is a developer building block that would also need the developer's own Stripe and PayPal relationships, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
